tasks.title: Install Docker on Mac
tasks.details:
1. Download Docker Desktop for Mac
2. Install and launch Docker
3. Verify Docker is running

tasks.title: Set up Home Assistant Container
tasks.description: Configure and run Home Assistant in Docker. Base configuration and `docker-compose.yml` are in place. Requires `secrets.yaml` to be populated by the user.
tasks.details:
1. Create docker-compose.yml
2. Set up configuration directory
3. Start Home Assistant container

tasks.title: Configure iRobot Integration
tasks.description: Connect Roomba to Home Assistant. iRobot integration is configured in `configuration.yaml` but requires `secrets.yaml` to be populated with actual credentials.
tasks.details:
1. Add iRobot integration
2. Enter credentials from .env
3. Verify Roomba connection

tasks.title: Create Roomba Automation
tasks.description: Set up automation to run Roomba when leaving home. Automations for starting/stopping Roomba based on iPhone presence are defined in `configuration.yaml`.
tasks.details:
1. Create automation in Home Assistant
2. Set trigger based on iPhone presence
3. Set action to start Roomba

tasks.title: Modify monitor_iphone.sh
tasks.description: Update script to trigger Home Assistant API. Script updated to use environment variables for configuration (see `.env.example`). Requires user to create `.env` with actual values, especially `HA_ACCESS_TOKEN`.
tasks.details:
1. Add Home Assistant API call on disconnect
2. Test the automation

tasks.title: Test and Verify
tasks.description: Test the complete automation flow. Requires user to complete setup (Docker, secrets, .env) and then test the full workflow.
tasks.details:
1. Test iPhone disconnect triggers Roomba
2. Verify Roomba starts cleaning
3. Check logs for any issues
